title: PhoneClaw — On-device iPhone AI Agent for Privacy
description:
PhoneClaw runs an AI agent directly on your iPhone to automate taps, messages and calendar tasks without sending data to the cloud. It uses Gemma 4 locally and can pair with a Mac for heavier models.
